name: Register a symlinked Linux worktree for Windows agy using the System32 fallback, preserving settings and avoiding the Linux store
Register accented and ampersand-containing Windows profiles through real cmd.exe without corrupting the profile path
Omit the executable or select a native executable and keep registration in the Linux profile
Attempt to trust a primary checkout, home, plain folder, subfolder, and unrelated worktree and observe refusal without profile writes
Supply malformed Windows settings or an unproven Windows home and observe refusal rather than Linux fallback
Launch Windows agy in a freshly registered Linux worktree without its folder-trust dialog
reason: Registered a fresh scratch git worktree using the resolved Windows agy executable and real cmd.exe/wslpath, then ran the real TUI for 45 seconds with a 120x40 drained pty and disposable Windows USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, HOME, and temp directories. The screen said "You are currently not signed in" and offered Google OAuth or a Google Cloud project; it never reached workspace trust. No dialog appeared, but authentication-blocked absence is not proof of suppression. An authorized preauthenticated disposable profile inside the worktree is needed; signing in or copying production credentials is outside this phase authority. Removed only the scratch trust entry, verified other keys preserved, and deleted the scratch repo/profile.
